Kyle.fact: Kyle takes the first bite of broth despite having no appetite, complying with an internal directive.
Kyle's stabilizer administered itself ninety-three minutes ago, two hours ahead of schedule, indicating a hardware malfunction causing half-second gaps in his perception.
Kyle gripped the railing when the hardware skipped on the stairs but kept walking and chose not to tell anyone about the malfunction.
Mrs. Chen notes that Kyle is early without framing it as a question, prompting him to offer only the single word 'Job' in response.
Mrs. Chen ladles more broth into Kyle's already-full bowl without being asked.
Kyle's hardware skips again for forty milliseconds while he is eating, causing his perception to fragment and the environment to briefly dissolve.
Kyle continues eating and pretends the hardware skip did not happen while Mrs. Chen shifts her gaze to watch the space where his hands are.
Mrs. Chen makes a pointed comparison between her broth and Uncle Noodle's, implying hers costs her something real while his is hollow formula.
Kyle's hardware processes Mrs. Chen's words as a statement about quality and standards, but an internal correction surfaces: she is not talking about noodles.
Kyle involuntarily catalogues impact scarring on Mrs. Chen's knuckles, registering it as repeated, symmetrical, and not from kitchen work.
Kyle picks up the chopsticks and eats the broth, thinking about the job and not about what the word 'formula' connects across his life.
Kyle pays Mrs. Chen and leaves without saying he will return, with both parties understanding implicitly that he will.
Kyle activates a terminal in the back of a parts shop to receive a contract transmission.

Sable transmits a contract directing Kyle to extract Dr. Yuna Ferreira from a Ferrogate BioSystems secondary facility before 0600, after which she will be moved to a secure wing and become a closed file.
Kyle asks who flagged Dr. Ferreira, framing it as a statement rather than a question.
Kyle chooses not to ask Sable the question that would force full disclosure, and instead accepts the contract by requesting approach data and a 0530 window confirmation.
Kyle lifts his hand from the activation plate, closing the terminal and ending the transmission.
Kyle deliberately stops his own heart using a piezoelectric discharge from his katana to simulate death and infiltrate a facility.
Kyle applies the blade grip to his sternum and triggers the discharge, stopping his heart.
Kyle wakes in a cold storage anteroom inside the secondary facility.
Kyle's implanted hardware corrects his cardiac arrhythmia and restarts his heart four seconds faster than he had calculated.
The smell of the cold storage room triggers a suppressed memory or recognition in Kyle — he has been inside a room like this before.
Kyle catalogs a technician's voice, badge number HX-7741, and the phrase 'street meat, bay three,' identifying him as a Helix subcontractor.

Sable reveals she has seen the intake manifest format for flagged researchers before, at a different facility in a different year, without disclosing what she was doing there or why she is routing this contract.

unnamed protagonist.fact: He enters his room in the dark and performs a series of ritualized actions: storing the katana, writing in his notebook, and checking the blade by feel.
Pixel arrives at his door unannounced, announcing herself with a specific knock pattern and a deflecting joke about the darkness.
Pixel scans the base of his skull with her diagnostic scanner, checking his neural hardware sync.
Pixel discovers three nodes with thermal stress markers on the lateral array, indicating hardware degradation he has known about for six days and withheld from her.
Pixel warns him that if delta-sync drops past eight percent variance, he will lose the boundary between his own signal and external bleed, causing something 'not him' to get louder.
He writes Φ60 in the notebook, tears out the page, and hands it to Pixel as payment despite her charging only Φ40.
Pixel leaves without looking back, signaling to him that she already knows where he is going.
